title: Финальное повторение: вся грамматика в одном тесте

why: Это карта всего курса на одной странице. Перед финальным тестом пройдись по ней и проверь: какую форму и какое время ты выберешь, чтобы выразить нужный смысл.
formation: • Present Simple: V / V-s. Present Continuous: am / is / are + V-ing.
• Present Perfect: have / has + V3. Present Perfect Continuous: have / has been + V-ing.
• Past Simple: V2 / did + V. Past Continuous: was / were + V-ing.
• Past Perfect: had + V3. Past Perfect Continuous: had been + V-ing.
• Будущее: will + V / be going to + V; Future Continuous: will be + V-ing; Future Perfect: will have + V3.
• Zero: if + Present, Present. First: if + Present, will + V.
• Second: if + Past, would + V (If I were you...). Third: if + Past Perfect, would have + V3.
• Mixed: if + Past Perfect, would + V. Wish: wish + Past Simple (сейчас), wish + Past Perfect (прошлое).
ПАССИВ: be + V3 (is done, was done, has been done, will be done).
КОСВЕННАЯ РЕЧЬ: сдвиг времён на шаг назад (is → was, will → would, Past Simple → Past Perfect); вопрос превращается в утверждение: She asked where I lived. Say + that, tell + человек.
МОДАЛЬНЫЕ: must be (наверняка), can't be (не может быть), might / may have + V3 (возможно, было), should have + V3 (надо было), needn't have + V3 (зря сделал).
ИНВЕРСИЯ: Never have I seen..., Hardly had I left when..., Not only did he..., Had I known..., Were I you...
usage: 1. Выбор времени: спроси себя, о каком периоде речь и важна ли связь с настоящим (Perfect) или указано точное время (Past Simple).
2. Условие: реально ли оно (First), нереально сейчас (Second) или уже невозможно (Third).
3. Пассив: важно действие или результат, а не исполнитель. (The bug was fixed. — Баг исправлен.)
4. Косвенная речь: пересказываешь чужие слова, поэтому сдвигаешь время и порядок слов.
5. Инверсия: усиливаешь мысль в формальном или литературном стиле.
signalWords: since / for / already / yet (Perfect), ago / yesterday (Past Simple), by the time (Past Perfect), if / unless (условные), never / hardly / no sooner (инверсия).
mistakes: ✗ I live here since 2020 → ✓ I've lived here since 2020
✗ If I will have time → ✓ If I have time
✗ He asked where do I work → ✓ He asked where I worked
✗ I wish I would have time → ✓ I wish I had time
✗ Hardly I had left → ✓ Hardly had I left
remember: Сначала смысл, потом форма: когда, насколько реально, кто важнее и что хочу подчеркнуть.

items.prompt: She ___ (work) here since 2019.
items.answer: has worked / has been working

items.prompt: If I ___ (be) you, I would call him.
items.answer: were / was

items.prompt: The report ___ (send) yesterday.
items.answer: was sent

items.prompt: He said that he ___ (be) tired.
items.answer: was

items.prompt: By the time we arrived, the film ___ (already / start).
items.answer: had already started

items.prompt: Never ___ (I / see) such a mess.
items.answer: have I seen

items.prompt: We ___ (not / finish) yet.
items.answer: haven't finished / have not finished

items.prompt: You ___ (not / have to) come; it's optional.
items.answer: don't have to / do not have to

items.prompt: I've known her ___ 2015. (a) for (b) since (c) ago
items.answer: since

items.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home. (a) stay (b) will stay (c) would stay
items.answer: will stay

items.prompt: I wish I ___ more time. (a) have (b) had (c) would have
items.answer: had

items.prompt: The bridge ___ in 1990. (a) built (b) is built (c) was built
items.answer: was built

items.prompt: She asked me where ___. (a) did I live (b) I lived (c) do I live
items.answer: I lived

items.prompt: He ___ be at home; I just saw him leave. (a) must (b) can't (c) should
items.answer: can't

items.prompt: ___ had we sat down than the phone rang. (a) No sooner (b) Hardly (c) Only
items.answer: No sooner

items.prompt: I'm used to ___ early. (a) get up (b) getting up (c) got up
items.answer: getting up

items.prompt: Passive: They fixed the bug yesterday.
items.answer: The bug was fixed yesterday.

items.prompt: Reported speech: "I am tired," she said.
items.answer: She said (that) she was tired. / She said she was tired. / She said that she was tired.

items.prompt: Third conditional (If...): I didn't study, so I failed.
items.answer: If I had studied, I wouldn't have failed. / If I had studied, I would have passed.

items.prompt: Wish: I don't have a car. (I wish...)
items.answer: I wish I had a car.

items.prompt: Inversion: I have never seen such a view. (Never...)
items.answer: Never have I seen such a view.

items.prompt: Reported question: "Where do you work?" he asked me.
items.answer: He asked me where I worked.

items.prompt: Relative clause (who): The developer is my friend. He fixed the bug.
items.answer: The developer who fixed the bug is my friend.

items.prompt: Modal (might): Perhaps she missed the train.
items.answer: She might have missed the train.

items.prompt: I live here since 2020.
items.answer: I've lived here since 2020. / I have lived here since 2020. / I have been living here since 2020. / I've been living here since 2020.

items.prompt: If I will have time, I'll help you.
items.answer: If I have time, I'll help you.

items.prompt: He asked me where do I work.
items.answer: He asked me where I worked.

items.prompt: She suggested to go to the cinema.
items.answer: She suggested going to the cinema.

items.prompt: I'm used to get up early.
items.answer: I'm used to getting up early.

items.prompt: The meeting has been cancel.
items.answer: The meeting has been canceled. / The meeting has been cancelled.

items.prompt: Hardly I had left when the phone rang.
items.answer: Hardly had I left when the phone rang.

items.prompt: I wish I would have more free time.
items.answer: I wish I had more free time.

items.prompt: Я работаю в этой компании с 2021 года.
items.answer: I've worked at this company since 2021. / I have worked at this company since 2021. / I have been working at this company since 2021. / I've been working at this company since 2021.

items.prompt: Если завтра будет дождь, мы отменим поездку.
items.answer: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the trip. / If it rains tomorrow, we'll cancel the trip.

items.prompt: Если бы я знал об этом раньше, я бы тебе помог.
items.answer: If I had known about it earlier, I would have helped you. / If I'd known about it earlier, I'd have helped you.

items.prompt: Этот баг был исправлен вчера.
items.answer: This bug was fixed yesterday. / The bug was fixed yesterday.

items.prompt: Он сказал, что закончил отчёт.
items.answer: He said he had finished the report. / He said that he had finished the report.

items.prompt: Хотел бы я говорить по-английски лучше.
items.answer: I wish I spoke English better. / I wish I could speak English better.

items.prompt: Он, должно быть, дома: свет горит.
items.answer: He must be at home; the light is on. / He must be at home: the lights are on. / He must be at home; the lights are on.

items.prompt: Никогда ещё я не видел такого сложного кода.
items.answer: Never have I seen such complicated code. / Never before have I seen such complicated code.
